title: Gideon and the Interior
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Noor Halloran, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
